name: Decision card (dilemma → options → choice)
definition: Wired columns: the dilemma, the options considered, the chosen option, the trade-off, and what changed.
bestUse: Slides about a hard choice and its consequences.

demo.how: The card wires the dilemma to the options considered and on to the choice, its trade-off and what changed. Select another option, by click or arrow keys, to see the road not taken; the Chosen tag stays on what the team actually picked. Reset returns to it. Content is illustrative.
